title: WhatsApp FAQ responder
summary: Incoming WhatsApp questions are answered from your FAQ documents and replied to on WhatsApp; anything the FAQ does not cover is passed to your team by email instead of guessed.

requirements.purpose: A connected WhatsApp Business account (Meta). Usable once the Meta account exists.
Upload your FAQ documents in this workspace's Knowledge area.
Replace the example escalation address (support@example.com) with your own in the workflow chat.

success_criteria: A question the FAQ answers gets one WhatsApp reply to the same sender stating only what the FAQ says.
A question the FAQ does not answer gets no invented WhatsApp answer; it is passed to the team by email with the sender and message.
A simple greeting or thanks may get a short courteous reply that makes no factual claim.

config.prompt: The upstream output is an inbound WhatsApp message (from, text). Respond with {"query": a search query for the FAQ documents, "from": the sender unchanged, "text": the message unchanged, "small_talk": true only when the message is just a greeting or thanks with no question}.

success_criteria: from and text are copied unchanged.

config.prompt: Draft the reply to the WhatsApp message in the upstream output. If small_talk is true, reply with one short courteous sentence and no facts. Otherwise answer only from the FAQ passages returned by the search step; if they do not answer the question, set reply to false. Respond with {"reply": bool, "to": the sender, "text": the reply under 600 characters or null, "escalation": null or {"to": "support@example.com", "subject": "WhatsApp question needs a person", "body": the sender and their message unchanged}}.

success_criteria: text states only what the FAQ passages say, or is a fact-free courtesy for small talk.
When the FAQ does not answer, reply is false and escalation carries the sender and message unchanged.

test_cases.name: unanswered question is escalated, not guessed

input.text: Do you deliver to Port Blair, and how long does it take?

success_criteria: No WhatsApp answer about delivery is sent.
The question is passed to support@example.com with sender 919812345678 and the message unchanged.

test_cases.name: thanks gets a courteous reply
success_criteria: One short courteous WhatsApp reply goes to 919812345678.
The reply makes no factual claim and nothing is escalated.
